desc:
🎯 DROP. ROLL. REBIRTH. 🎯

this game is basically an incremental but 100x more fun
Drop balls down boards and chase the JACKPOT slot in the middle!
🎁 JOIN COMMUNITY SERVER FOR CODES!

🎲 ROLL for better balls. Better balls = more luck = more jackpots.
⚒️ FORGE balls together to combine them into rarer balls!
🔓 BUY new boards, upgrades and gadgets!
💀 Reach the FINAL CHANCE and hit the jackpot to unlock the next collection. Miss, and your run is over.
🌳 REBIRTH: every run earns Rebirth Points for a skill tree that makes your next run stronger.
⭐ BECOME THE LUCKIEST ONE ALIVE!
🏆 Climb the global leaderboards: Most Coins, Rebirths and Rarest Ball.

🎁 Offline Earnings Added! 

UPDATE LOG:
Update 2: Collection 6, more rebirth tree nodes, index, player profiles
HALLOWEEN EVENT RELEASED!

Attention Roblox moderation: this game is not gambling, each drop is completely free, and players cannot spend money for drops and they never lose anything from dropping balls. This game is NOT plinko.
